name: Plasma-TS-TW
title: Plasma
description: A raymarched mass of white and grey folds against black, like dense smoke or melting wax. The form kneads and re-forms continuously, and dragging the pointer nudges its shape.
use: A dark abstract hero needs slow, heavy organic movement with no content of its own.
avoid: You want colour: unless a tint is passed the surface renders white and grey.
a11y: Decorative and always morphing, with no reduced-motion check despite the constant movement. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Smooth, rounded volumes of white and mid-grey emerging from a black field, with soft shading that hints at depth. Edges are blurry and slightly stepped, and the composition sits mostly in the upper half.
behaves: The mass bulges and contracts at a slow, even rate, with brighter highlights swelling and fading. Pointer movement shifts the field so the shape responds to the cursor, then eases back.
customise: Tint colour, speed, direction (including ping-pong), scale, opacity and pointer interaction are props. The raymarch shape itself is fixed.
weight: heavy: A per-pixel raymarch loop of sixty steps runs every animation frame.
issues: The default colour makes the plasma render white and grey, not the colourful swirl the description suggests.
Blob edges show stair-stepping and stay soft out of focus.
polishWhy: A pleasant organic mass, but it is mushy, aliased and colourless as recorded.
